# FlowCollector default values

These are the values the NetObserv operator applies when the corresponding fields are
not set in the `FlowCollector` resource.

Unlike OpenAPI defaults, they are applied in memory during reconciliation and are
**not** written back into the resource: a minimal `FlowCollector` stays minimal once
applied. Anything you do set always takes precedence.

See [FlowCollector.md](./FlowCollector.md) for the full API reference.

```yaml
apiVersion: flows.netobserv.io/v1beta2
kind: FlowCollector
metadata:
  name: cluster
spec:
  agent:
    ebpf:
      cacheActiveTimeout: 15s
      excludeInterfaces:
      - lo
      kafkaBatchSize: 1048576
      logLevel: info
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 800Mi
        requests:
          cpu: 100m
          memory: 50Mi
  consolePlugin:
    enable: true
    logLevel: info
    portNaming:
      enable: true
    quickFilters:
    - default: true
      filter:
        flow_layer: '"app"'
      name: Applications
    - filter:
        flow_layer: '"infra"'
      name: Infrastructure
    - default: true
      filter:
        dst_kind: '"Pod"'
        src_kind: '"Pod"'
      name: Pods network
    - filter:
        dst_kind: '"Service"'
      name: Services network
    - filter:
        src_subnet_label: '"",EXT:'
      name: External ingress
    - filter:
        dst_subnet_label: '"",EXT:'
      name: External egress
    replicas: 1
    resources:
      limits:
        memory: 100Mi
      requests:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 50Mi
  deploymentModel: Service
  kafka:
    compression: none
  loki:
    lokiStack:
      name: loki
    manual:
      ingesterUrl: http://loki:3100/
      querierUrl: http://loki:3100/
      tenantID: netobserv
    microservices:
      ingesterUrl: http://loki-distributor:3100/
      querierUrl: http://loki-query-frontend:3100/
      tenantID: netobserv
    mode: Monolithic
    monolithic:
      tenantID: netobserv
      url: http://loki:3100/
    readTimeout: 30s
    writeBatchSize: 10485760
    writeBatchWait: 1s
    writeTimeout: 10s
  processor:
    kafkaConsumerBatchSize: 10485760
    kafkaConsumerQueueCapacity: 1000
    logLevel: info
    logTypes: Flows
    resources:
      limits:
        memory: 800Mi
      requests:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 100Mi
    service:
      tlsType: Auto
  prometheus:
    querier:
      enable: true
      manual:
        url: http://prometheus:9090
      mode: Auto
      timeout: 30s
```
